spoken: this section explains how we triage incoming auto claims during storm events, um, when the volume goes above roughly three hundred new claims a day, the intake team switches to the surge workflow, which means that every claim gets a severity score at first notice of loss instead of waiting for an adjuster, scores of one and two are cosmetic damage and can be handled through the photo estimating app, uh, without an inspection, scores of three and above go to a field adjuster, and anything involving an injury goes straight to the bodily injury unit regardless of the score, the point is not to process faster for its own sake, it's to make sure the people with undrivable cars or injuries hear from us within twenty four hours, no, within forty eight hours, twenty four was the old target and we never hit it, lucasta's team owns the scoring rubric and reviews it after every event
intended: This section explains how we triage incoming auto claims during storm events. When the volume goes above roughly 300 new claims a day, the intake team switches to the surge workflow, which means that every claim gets a severity score at first notice of loss instead of waiting for an adjuster. Scores of 1 and 2 are cosmetic damage and can be handled through the photo estimating app without an inspection. Scores of 3 and above go to a field adjuster, and anything involving an injury goes straight to the bodily injury unit regardless of the score. The point is not to process faster for its own sake, it's to make sure the people with undrivable cars or injuries hear from us within 48 hours, 24 was the old target and we never hit it. Lucasta's team owns the scoring rubric and reviews it after every event.

Gutters dented along the whole back of the house. The siding is vinyl and has a few holes on the west side, I counted 11. He mentioned water coming into the upstairs bedroom, but when we checked the ceiling there's no staining and the moisture meter read normal, so I'm noting it as unconfirmed. He was cooperative and has receipts for the roof replacement in 2016. Recommend full roof replacement, gutter replacement on the rear elevation, siding repair on the west elevation, and two skylights.

spoken: a lot of customers ask why their system produced less in december than the estimate in their proposal, the short answer is that the estimate is an annual number, and it's spread unevenly across the year, in the winter months the sun is lower, the days are shorter, and in some areas the panels are covered in snow for days at a time, uh, so a system that makes nine thousand kilowatt hours a year might only make three or four hundred in december and well over a thousand in june, this is normal and it's already accounted for in the the annual estimate, if your production is lower than expected over a full twelve months, er, over a full year, not a single month, then it's worth calling us, and we'll check the monitoring data for shading, a failed optimizer or an inverter fault, you can reach the service team at service at brightfield solar dot com
intended: A lot of customers ask why their system produced less in December than the estimate in their proposal. The short answer is that the estimate is an annual number, and it's spread unevenly across the year. In the winter months the sun is lower, the days are shorter, and in some areas the panels are covered in snow for days at a time, so a system that makes 9,000 kilowatt hours a year might only make 300 or 400 in December and well over 1,000 in June. This is normal and it's already accounted for in the annual estimate. If your production is lower than expected over a full year, not a single month, then it's worth calling us, and we'll check the monitoring data for shading, a failed optimizer or an inverter fault. You can reach the service team at service@brightfieldsolar.com.

intended:
Returns and recalls. When a manufacturer recall notice comes in, the pharmacist on duty is responsible for checking our stock the same day, not the next morning. Pull every affected batch from the shelves and the dispensary fridge, put it in the red quarantine tub, and log the batch numbers and quantities in the recall folder.
